text:
maria: anyone else seeing suppressed pages from the notify-orchestrator? multiple customers pinged support that they didn't get alerts at 11:23am PT

simon: yep saw a support ticket thread too. looks like pages were generated but never sent to outbound gateway. no obvious 5xx in the service logs.

aj: I pulled the dispatcher logs — lots of `suppressor: drop due to stale_state` entries. that's weird, suppressor TTL shouldn't be infinite.

lisa: @aj can you paste a sample log line?

aj: sure:
```
2026-03-17T18:23:10Z notify-orchestrator suppressor=notifier-suppressor state=stale ttl=-1 id=notif-usr-123 action=drop
```

chris: negative TTL (-1) looks like a bug in state refresh path after redeploy. did we roll anything recently?

maria: we did a small config roll for the suppressor yesterday to change default window. rollout completed 02:15Z with no errors.

oncall-bot: New incident created: INC-2026-0345 by maria — "notify-orchestrator suppressed outbound pages". Pager escalation disabled due to suppressor.

aj: quick check — redis key for suppressor states is present but shows stale timestamp. running `redis-cli GET suppressor:state:region-us`
```
"{\"last_seen\":1640995200, \"ttl\":-1, \"version\":\"v2.1.3\"}"
```

simon: that last_seen is Epoch 2022-01-01, wow. state never refreshed on restart. maybe the refresh loop failed to start.

lisa: i'll attempt a graceful restart of the refresh worker on prod-canary, then scale back to prod if it looks healthy. doing: `kubectl -n notify rollout restart deployment/notifier-refresh`

maria: please hold on manual paging for customers until we confirm fallback works. if manual page needed, follow the manual-paging checklist: add "manual-page" tag in incident, call #oncall-phone, and log in incident doc.

chris: test after restart:
```
# health check for refresh
curl -sS https://notify-internal/refresh/health || true
# inspect redis key again
redis-cli GET suppressor:state:region-us
```

ops-bot: Deployment notifier-refresh restarted by lisa (kube rollout). Observed 1/1 pods ready after 22s.

aj: redis key updated after restart:
```
"{\"last_seen\":1710638600, \"ttl\":300, \"version\":\"v2.2.0\"}"
```

maria: good. can someone confirm outbound pages flow is back? try simple alert that triggers paging for test team.

simon: sent test alert -> no suppression, outbound gateway accepted 200. pager logs show delivery to provider. :white_check_mark:

maria: OK restoring normal paging. next steps: 1) rollback yesterday's suppressor config change (it introduced edge case where refresh worker startup path didn't set TTL), 2) add startup health probe that fails fast if refresh loop not running, 3) add alarm on suppressor negative-ttl occurrences.

aj: i'll open a PR for the rollback and health probe, add unit test for state initialization.

lisa: i'll run a patch through canary and schedule a brief maintenance window for prod rollback.

chris: for customer impact — support estimated ~12 missed pages across 3 customers, we've opened CS tickets and put a note in the incident. recommend outreach to affected accounts.

maria: thanks team. tagging follow-ups on the incident doc and scheduling postmortem for tomorrow. closing slack thread for live mitigation.
